title: Practice 5: Verbs that take the instrumental

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Вы занимаетесь ___ (присвоение) предложений, чтобы их исправить?
exercises.prompt: Have you been adopting sentences in order to correct them?
exercises.why: «After the verbs командовать and заведовать the units or persons being commanded … are denoted by the instrumental case.» «This verb (заниматься) may be followed by the Instrumental case.» «The object following this verb (пользоваться) is in the Instrumental case.» — DLI, Lessons 30, 65, 99.
